potential_user_journeys.scenario_description: Users can browse through different product categories to find items of interest.

steps.element_description: Category link for Accessories, Men, or Women.

expected_outcome: User is redirected to the selected category page displaying relevant products.

potential_user_journeys.scenario_description: Users can set a price range to filter products displayed in the store.

steps.element_description: Price range slider to set minimum and maximum prices.
Filter button to apply the price range.

expected_outcome: Filtered list of products within the specified price range is displayed.

potential_user_journeys.scenario_description: Users can sort the products by different criteria for easier navigation.

steps.element_description: Dropdown menu to choose sorting criteria such as popularity or price.

expected_outcome: Products are sorted based on the selected criteria.

potential_user_journeys.scenario_description: Users can click on a product to view its detailed information and add it to the cart.
expected_outcome: Product detail page is displayed with options to add to the cart.
